title: BidNet: A Hierarchical Deep Learning Approach for Simulating Multilevel Auction Data
summary: A research repository that trains a hierarchical deep-generative model (BidNet) to simulate multilevel, high-cardinality first-price sealed-bid auction data, benchmarking it against CTGAN and TVAE baselines built from adapted deep-generative source. The transformer module for these baselines calls rdt's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder directly, and locally vendored CTGAN/TVAE modules are trained and compared as competing synthesizers.
